rows.en: Oswald: "Ugh..."
Kururu: "Oh, Mom! I think he's awake!"
Oswald: "Wh-where... am I?"
???: "Don't worry. This is Cornel Village.
You were badly hurt when you washed up
on the riverbank nearby."
Oswald: "Hurt...? Ugh!"
???: "You mustn't move yet.
Just take your time and rest here until your wounds heal."
Oswald: "...I'm sorry for the trouble."
???: "We all help each other when we're in trouble.
I'm Thora, and this is my daughter, Kururu."
Kururu: "It's nice to meet you, mister!"
Oswald: "'Mister'? You're making me feel old...
So, you're the one who found me.
I have a faint memory of that."
Kururu: "Ahem!"
Oswald: "Heh heh heh..."
Thora: "..."
Oswald: "...Forgive me. I haven't introduced myself. I'm Os...
No, my name is Clime Strass."
Thora: "Mr. Strass, is it?"
Oswald: "Just Clime will be fine."
Kururu: "It's nice to meet you, Uncle Clime!"
Oswald: "Yes, it's nice to meet you too, Kururu..."
Touya: "Ugh..."
Touya: "Aaagh! Shut up!!"
Melvi: "Ooh..."
Touya: "Huh?"
Melvi: "Ooh... *sniff, sniff*..."
Touya: "S-sorry... I-I didn't mean..."
Yamato: "Hey! Why are you making a girl
cry?! Melvi only came
to wake you up, you know?!"
Melvi: "...I-I'm sorry... *sniff*..."
Touya: "Uh, no, I'm, um, sorry I yelled.
I'm not mad at you..."
Melvi: "...Really?"
Touya: "Y-yeah! You just startled me a little, that's all!
Ha ha ha ha ha!"
Melvi: "...I'm glad."
Touya: "Whew..."
Ai: "Heeey! How long are you going to keep me waiting?"
Touya: "Hm? That's Ai downstairs..."
Yamato: "Oh, right. Ai's here to get you.
But you just wouldn't wake up, nyo matter what..."
Paldia: "Good morning."
Touya: "Oh, good morning."
Ai: "Honestly... *munch, munch*... I went to all the trouble
of coming to get you... *gulp, gulp*...
*chew, chew*...
and you had the nerve to sleep like a log... *munch, munch*..."
Touya: "...Why are you stuffing your face?"
Ai: "Do you want some too? This pie's really good."
Touya: "Yeah... *munch, munch*...
Mmm, it is... Hey, that's not the point!"
Ai: "Why are you so grumpy? Aren't you getting enough calcium?"
Paldia: "There's a portion for you too, Touya,
so don't worry. Come on, sit down there."
Touya: "Y-yes...
...So, what did you want?"
Ai: "Huh? ...*sluuurp*... *gulp*... What?"
Touya: "...*sigh*"
Ai: "I'm kidding. Some people from the Agarthian Council
are coming, so Lodis asked me
to go and get you."
Touya: "The council? What for?"
Ai: "I don't know. But if they want you,
it's probably about Rayblade, isn't it?"
Touya: "Then that goes for you too, doesn't it?"
Ai: "Yeah. But I said no.
So in exchange, you absolutely have to be there."
Touya: "...You know, you..."
Melvi: "So you really were the one piloting Rayblade,
Big Brother Touya!"
Touya: "Y-yeah..."
Melvi: "That's amazing... I'd love to ride in it..."
Touya: "Huh? You're interested in Spirit Mechs too, Melvi?"
Melvi: "Yeah! I can pilot a Spirit Mech too, you know!"
Paldia: "What? Melvi, what do you mean?!"
Melvi: "Daddy let me use the simulator.
He praised me and said I had 'aptitude'!"
Paldia: "Honestly, that man..."
Touya: "What is he making his own daughter do...?"
Ai: "Well, I've had plenty to eat. Shall we get going?
Thanks for the meal, Ms. Paldia."
Paldia: "Oh, no, you're very welcome."
Touya: "Yeah. Ms. Paldia,
we'll be off for a bit."
Paldia: "All right. See you later."
Melvi: "Hey, Mommy. Can I go with them too?"
Paldia: "Huh?"
Ai: "I don't see why not.
Melvi might know her way around better than we do."
Touya: "Yeah, she might... Is that okay with you?"
Paldia: "Don't do anything too dangerous."
Melvi: "Okaaay! Yamato, let's go!"
Paldia: "Please take care of her."
Touya: "Of course. See you later."
Lodis: "Thank you for coming.
I expect Ai has already told you,
but the members of the Agarthian Council will be here shortly.
Officially, they are investigating Rayblade's activation,
but their real purpose is probably to secure our agreement
to the proposal I mentioned yesterday.
You need only tell them about your experience piloting Rayblade.
Lady Ivel and I will handle the rest."
Touya: "I might let something slip that I shouldn't."
Lodis: "Dei Rakbal is a sensible man.
There is no need to worry.
Just tell them exactly what you saw.
My concern is how the other council members will respond,
but there is little point in speculating now..."
Fain: "Your Highness! W-we have a problem!"
Lodis: "What has you in such a panic?"
Fain: "J-just look at the monitor!"
??: "...Until now, the Holy Land's official position
regarding Rayblade has been
that the location of its seal was unknown.
But look at this recorded footage.
It had already been excavated and hidden, of all places,
in that inviolable sanctuary, the Holy Land! Furthermore..."
Lodis: "...What... is the meaning of this?"
Miyasco: "Oh... Maki..."
Fain: "It really is...
Honestly, Maki hasn't changed a bit..."
Maki: "...There is no doubt that the mysterious machine fighting Rayblade
was the very one responsible for the tragedy 109 years ago:
Ze=Ode.
We were not even informed of the danger
of its return. Worse still, the leaders of each nation
knew these facts and concealed them.
Is this not a grave betrayal
of the people?
Furthermore, the theory that Rayblade
triggered the Terror of Ze=Ode
has yet to receive a clear answer.
We will continue to investigate these many deceptions
and Rayblade itself,
for as long as the truth remains hidden...
This is Maki Theora Tres, reporting from the scene."
Lodis: "This is bad..."
Ymir: "The governments will shift the blame to the Holy Land
to justify their own actions.
And our Spirit Mech development leaves us vulnerable..."
Touya: "How does that make you vulnerable?"
Ymir: "The Holy Land is forbidden to aid any particular country,
regardless of the reason.
Officially, Spirit Mech development is under the Holy Land's jurisdiction,
but in practice, York has been leading it.
It's easy to imagine them attacking that point.
At worst, they might demand that control of the Spirit Mechs
be divided among the nations."
Touya: "I get it. Adults and their dirty tricks.
So, when does this investigation start?"
Lodis: "As I said, the council members will arrive
shortly. They will then meet with Lady Ivel,
and the interview comes after that, so we still have some time.
I wanted to explain the circumstances
before you actually spoke to them. Should I have called you later?"
Touya: "It's fine. I only just woke up,
so I'll take a walk around and clear my head."
Ymir: "I'd like to show you around myself, but..."
Touya: "Don't worry about it. See you later."
????: "The activation was successful, but...
your actions went rather too far."
Lyle: "..."
?????: "Indeed, you did go too far.
Had Rayblade not appeared then,
you would have crushed it, pilot and all.
It was fortunate you didn't know about him."
Lyle: "...Why did you keep quiet?"
?????: "Had I told you, you would surely have gone
to kill him.
I could not allow that.
Besides, he is not Lenis."
Lyle: "To me, he is Lenis."
?????: "Good grief..."
From now on, you are forbidden to act without permission."
Lyle: "!! Who the hell do you think you are?!"
????: "! You! It was your reckless behavior
that brought this situation about!
Because of your obsession with Rayblade, the Doctor..."
Lyle: "..."
?????: "At any rate, your Rayode needs repairs.
Please lie low for a while.
Also, it seems Zigrim is preparing for war.
It will be troublesome if they do anything too reckless,
so please keep them on a suitable leash."
Lyle: "...Tch. Fine."
????: "Please look after him.
He seems to dislike me, after all."
?????: "He must dislike beautiful women."
????: "Heh heh... You are as bad at flattery as ever."
?????: "Why do you think so?"
????: "Dr. Wenimas was beautiful.
In a way, I even admired her."
????: "More importantly, there is Rayblade. Things have gone
well so far, but judging by his actions,
it may be difficult to make him one of our comrades."
?????: "Yes. Queen Alforina's wishes have taken root
in his heart. Essentially, he is a member
of an organization opposed to us."
????: "Alforina El Istarsh...
It seems her death has actually worked
against us.
Though things might have been the same had she lived...
What a troublesome person."
?????: "Indeed. Even in death."
????: "At any rate, it seems I shall have to make contact
with him myself. Then there is the matter of the Doctor's whereabouts..."
?????: "She has gone to investigate, hasn't she?"
????: "Yes. I wasn't expecting much,
but we managed to find someone who fits the description."
?????: "Someone? Not the Doctor in person?"
????: "Correct. The situation seems a little complicated,
but it is hardly a serious problem.
I have also sent that girl with a message,
so the Doctor should soon..."
?????: "So the time has finally come?"
????: "Yes. Three years... At last, we have come this far...
And now, everything begins... Heh heh heh heh..."
Touya: "Hm? That's... Clovis...
What's he doing?"
Touya: "Boxing? Is he... training?"
Clovis: "Hey, Touya. What are you doing out here?"
Touya: "What are YOU doing?
All the way out here, where nobody can see you..."
Clovis: "This is the sort of thing you do in private, right?
Besides, it doesn't fit my image."
Touya: "But wouldn't you be better off training
in a Spirit Mech instead?"
Clovis: "If it were just about technique, yes.
But a Spirit Mech is a machine that responds more strongly
to its pilot's Prana.
If you neglect your own training, you'll always be relying
on the Spirit Mech's performance. You have to understand
that it's a human being who makes the machine move."
Touya: "...You actually say sensible things sometimes."
Clovis: "A little contrast is good, right?
It's a useful trick when you're chatting someone up, too."
Touya: "...I was an idiot to be impressed, even for a second."
Clovis: "Ha ha ha! Well, the point is your state of mind.
If you just sit there without thinking, you'll never be piloting it.
You'll just be along for the ride.
It isn't about 'technique' or 'strength.'
First, you have to feel it with your heart."
Touya: "My heart...? So instead of thinking it through,
I should feel it as an image?"
Clovis: "Oh...? Interesting.
Touya, try swinging that sword over there."
Touya: "Sword? Oh, this one?"
Clovis: "You're Japanese. You can at least swing a sword, right?"
Touya: "Hey, don't tell me you're another one who thinks
all Japanese people are samurai."
Clovis: "Of course not. I heard Japanese high schools
have a subject called 'kendo.'
Am I wrong?"
Touya: "Kendo and a real sword are different. And doesn't the curriculum
depend on the school? Mine didn't have it.
But I have studied swordsmanship before."
Clovis: "Oh? That sounds rather serious."
Touya: "It wasn't anything special.
My grandpa runs a dojo out in the country.
I was just made to take lessons there for a while.
So I can barely manage the basics."
Clovis: "I see, I see. A solid enough foundation...
My hunch was right, then.
All right, try swinging that sword for now."
Touya: "Well, I don't mind..."
Clovis: "What's with that awkward stance?
Take this seriously."
Touya: "Oh, shut up..."
Clovis: "That's it. Next..."
Touya: "*huff, huff*... H-hey... Are we still doing this...?"
Clovis: "...Well, that should be about enough...
Okay, this time, try it with your eyes closed."
Touya: "Yeah, yeah..."
Clovis (He picks things up frighteningly fast...)
Touya: "Hey, how, long, do I,
have to, keep doing, this?"
Clovis: "All right, stop."
Touya: "What good is any of this supposed to do?"
Clovis: "Just bear with me.
Now, hold that sword in a firm stance."
Touya: "...Sheesh. Like this?"
Clovis: "Good. Now close your eyes."
Touya: "Huh?"
Clovis: "Don't worry. I won't do anything to you."
Touya: "W-were you planning to?!"
Clovis: "I'm joking."
Touya: "All right, all right."
Clovis: "Stay like that and picture it in your mind.
Yourself, fighting in Zeifon."
Touya: "Huh? That's easy for you to say..."
Clovis: "Quit arguing!"
Touya: "You're enjoying this, aren't you?"
Clovis: "Of course I am. You're entertaining.
Come on, hurry up and do as you're told."
Touya: "Fine."
Touya: "Wh-what was that just now...?"
Clovis: "Heh. I'm not such a bad teacher, am I?
Touya, that sensation just now. Remember it."
Touya: "H-hey! What do you mean?"
Clovis: "You just grasped it with your heart.
Now all you need is actual combat."
Touya: "That doesn't answer my question!"
Clovis: "It's something I was taught three years ago.
Once you can reliably picture that sensation,
you should be able to pilot a Spirit Mech better than ever.
Probably Rayblade too. It's up to you from here on.
Don't forget what you just felt."
Touya: "H-hey! Don't just decide we're done!
...Sheesh..."
Touya: "...But that feeling just now..."
Touya: "Is that... Reduce?
What's he doing in front of that rock?"
Reduce: "Haaaaaaaah... Hah!!"
Touya: "N-no way! He cut through that rock...?"
Reduce: "Whew...
...Hm? Ah, Touya."
Touya: "...What the heck is that blade made of?"
Reduce: "I see. You were watching.
It was forged from an ore called 'Hardstone,'
but it is not so different from an ordinary sword."
Touya: "But just now..."
Reduce: "Heh heh heh. You cannot cut that rock
by relying on strength alone,
no matter how fine a blade this may be."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Reduce: "You must sense your own Prana.
Feel it with your heart, picture it, and channel it into the blade.
That is all."
Touya: "Huh?"
Reduce: "...When you pilot a Spirit Mech,
you do not consciously think through every next movement
as you operate it, do you?
You follow a vague image,
much as you do when moving your own body. Am I right?"
Touya: "W-well, now that you mention it, yeah...
But what's that got to do with this?"
Reduce: "You must perceive it naturally.
Perceive what is there. Then ask your heart, not what you will do,
but what you wish to do.
Strengthen that image within yourself.
Do not think it through with your head. Feel it with your heart."
Touya: "Now I'm even more confused..."
Reduce: "...Try holding this."
Touya: "Your sword? ...Urgh! Wh-what is this thing?
How many kilos does it weigh?!"
Reduce: "Try swinging it."
Touya: "Are you kidding? I can barely
lift this thing!"
Reduce: "Just try it."
Touya: "...Hyaaah! Whoa! Wh-wh-whoa...!"
Reduce: "That is because you are trying to swing it by force alone.
Swing without resisting the flow of the movement.
Then you need only control the direction of that flow."
Touya: "Y-you make it sound so easy...
Hup! Like this...?"
Touya: "Whoa...! W-w-whoa!"
Reduce: "Oh...? You have already grasped the knack.
Your body is moving with the proper 'flow'...
Have you studied under someone before?"
Touya: "Hm? Come to think of it, I remember being forced through
some grueling drills at my grandpa's dojo in the country..."
Reduce: "I see. He must be a man
well versed in swordsmanship.
I can almost see his pure, clean sword strokes in your movements."
Touya: "No way..."
Reduce: "That is how sound your movements are.
And to think that, even without continuing your practice,
your body still remembers. Heh heh heh. Fascinating.
If you trained seriously, you might surpass me before long..."
Touya: "Y-you think so?"
Reduce: "Good. Now take a stance with that sword."
Touya: "L-like this? I-it's a little heavy..."
Reduce: "Stay like that and take a slow, deep breath.
Then imagine that air gathering at the tip of the blade."
Touya: "How am I supposed to... Oh, right. Imagine it."
Reduce: "Exactly. Close your eyes and concentrate.
Do not think it through."
Touya: "O-okay..."
Touya: "What... was that feeling just now...?"
Reduce: "Astonishing... To think you could do so much..."
Touya: "You're just a good teacher.
Anyway, I saw something like a light just now..."
Reduce: "Once you can experience that sensation
at will..."
Touya: "I'll be able to cut through rocks too?"
Reduce: "Not quite that much yet, I should think.
But with training, you may come to be able to do it.
More importantly, it should help you pilot a Spirit Mech.
I hear they respond more strongly to their pilots' Prana.
Rather than piloting by technique alone,
if you feel it with your heart, as you did just now,
you should be able to draw out greater power."
Touya: "Huh. It doesn't really feel real to me yet."
Reduce: "That is assuming you remember the sensation
you just experienced. Still, it is mainly a matter of getting used to it.
You should be fine, so long as you keep up your training.
Now, I shall take my leave."
Touya: "My heart... huh... All right!"
Touya: "Whew... I never knew working out
could feel this good...
Heh heh. Funny, isn't it...?"
???: "Are you Touya?"
Touya: "..."
???: "Don't be so wary.
Do I really look that suspicious?"
Touya: "I'd say 'bewitching' is more like it."
???: "Heh heh heh. I'll take that
as a compliment."
Touya: "Anyway, who are you?"
???: "Oh, forgive me.
I serve Dei Rakbal, chairman of the Agarthian Council,
as his secretary.
My name is Doris Benfis. It's a pleasure."
Touya: "H-hey, don't come any closer."
Doris: "Now, you need to wipe that sweat off properly,
or you'll catch a cold..."
Doris: "I'm... very attracted to people who give their all
to something... Especially men like you..."
Touya: "H-hey..."
Doris: "Heh heh heh...
You don't need to be so tense.
...Is this your first time doing something like this?"
Touya: "S-stop it..."
Doris: "Your body doesn't seem to mind.
Which should I believe, your words or your body?"
Touya: "Ugh..."
Derock: "Hm hm hm, hm hm hmmm...♪"
Doris: "!?"
Derock: "Hm hmmm... Gyoof, gyoof!♪ ...Hm?"
Doris: "..."
Derock: "Oh, it's Touya over there, you know.
And that lady is... Ahaaa.
This is what they call a 'tryst,' you know."
Touya: "Huh?! Like hell it is!"
Derock: "Hmm. You don't have to hide it, you know.
You and I don't keep secrets from each other, you know.
Come now, don't mind me. Carry on, you know."
Doris: "..."
Derock: "Y-your eyes aren't smiling, you know...
I-I'll be going now, you know..."
Doris: "I never expected an interruption
in such a deserted spot...
Touya, we'll pick this up another time."
Doris: "See you, then. Bye-bye."
Touya: "..."
Touya: "W-well, I should head back..."
Lodis: "Come in."
Touya: "Excuse me."
Doris: "...Heh heh."
Touya: "Ah..."
Lodis: "Hm? Is something wrong?"
Touya: "N-no, it's nothing."
Councilor A: "...By the way, young man. What is that at your feet?"
Yamato (*bristles*)
Touya: "...Yamato."
Councilor A: "That is not what I am asking.
I am asking why you have brought
such a thing here."
Councilor B: "Quite right.
Have you lost your mind?
Bringing a beast into such a solemn gathering..."
Yamato (A b-b-b-beast?!)
Touya: "......Yamato is my family.
It's none of anybody else's business."
Councilor A: "What?!"
Councilor B: "Well! How dare you speak to us that way?!
Chairman! Say something..."
??: "Ms. Annabella, Mr. Wargs, please calm down.
Surely it does no harm. This is neither a committee of inquiry
nor an interrogation, after all."
Wargs: "Hmph... That is true, but..."
Annabella: "You are too lenient, Chairman!
Being a Spirit Mech pilot does not give him the right
to do whatever he pleases!
An insult to us is an insult to the nation. Besides..."
??: "...We are not so important as that.
We are merely the spokespeople
for each and every citizen.
We must not forget that."
Annabella: "..."
??: "...My apologies. I hope you will forgive their rudeness.
...It is Mr. Kazami, correct?"
Touya: "Just Touya is fine."
??: "Very well.
I am Dei Rakbal, chairman of the Agarthian Council.
It's a pleasure to meet you, Touya."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya! What kind of answer is that?!
You ought to mind your manners a little, you knyow!"
Wargs: "!!"
Dei: "Oh...? You can speak?"
Yamato: "Oh... H-ha ha ha... Meow."
Dei: "Ha ha ha ha! How very interesting.
Is this your doing, Clasio?"
Ymir: "Huh? No, it was Gabon..."
Dei: "Gabon?"
Ymir: "The Liebhofen's doctor.
His name is Gabon Jin Boleisho."
Doris: "..."
Dei: "I see. That man... He seems a most interesting
person. ...Now, Touya.
Would you tell us how you came to pilot Rayblade?"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Maki: "Well, well. So this is Rayblade...
It doesn't look all that evil.
No, no! I can't let appearances fool me!
I have to uncover the truth."
Celica: "Hm? Hey! Who are you?!
Civilians aren't allowed in here!"
Maki: "How rude! I'm a journalist!"
Celica: "...Which makes you very much a civilian."
Maki: "The people have a right to know the facts.
And I have a duty to report them."
Celica: "Oh, come on! Enough arguing. Just get..."
Maki: "...What?"
Celica: "*staaare*..."
Maki: "Wh-what is it?!"
Celica: "What's... that?"
Reisuke: "Beep beep beep... Beep-boop?"
Maki: "Oh, th-this? This is Reisuke.
My trusty partner... Hey, what are you doing?!"
Celica: "Huh? I was just wondering what it looks like inside..."
Maki: "Don't just take it apart!
There are only five of these in the whole world!"
Celica: "Hmm..."
Maki: "I told you, don't touch it!
Oh, you're getting oil on it with those hands..."
Maki: "Aaaah! What are you planning to do with that drill?!"
Clovis: "Oh, Celica. You seem to be having fun."
Maki: "Hey, don't just stand there watching! Help... Huh?
Did you just say Celica?"
Clovis: "Hm? Yes. Celica Laniard Mestina.
That's her name."
Maki: "Mestina...? The first princess of the Kingdom of Agarthia?
No way! But she's covered in oil... A-ahem!"
Celica: "People often say I don't act like a princess.
Hey, never mind that. Give me this."
Maki: "What? I-I'm afraid I can't, Your Highness!"
Celica: "As your princess, I command you!"
Maki: "NO!"
Celica: "Stingy!"
Maki: "Oh, honestly! I-I'll back off
for today, but I WILL get to the truth!"
Clovis: "I see. I thought I'd seen her somewhere before.
She's that journalist. Still, that was pretty good.
What a brilliant way to drive her off."
Celica: "Huh? What are you talking about?"
Clovis: "What do you mean...? Weren't you putting on an act
to get rid of her...?"
Celica: "Why would I need to do that?
Anyway, that was such a missed opportunity...
Next time I see it, I'm definitely capturing it."
Clovis: "...You've taken it so far it's almost impressive. Honestly."
Dei: "...I see. I understand the general course of events.
But why did Rayblade, which had never moved before,
move of its own accord?
Why were you and Ai able to pilot it?
It seems there is still much to investigate..."
Wargs: "Chairman, about that other matter..."
Dei: "Ah, yes.
Touya, thank you for your cooperation.
...Clasio, please look after Touya."
Ymir: "Yes, Professor... Oh, excuse me..."
Dei: "No, it's quite all right. I'll leave him in your care."
Ymir: "Yes. Let's go, Touya."
Touya: "Hey, why did you call him 'Professor' just now...?"
Ymir: "Oh, before Mr. Rakbal became chairman,
he taught here."
Touya: "So that's why you call him Professor..."
Ymir: "Yes. He's also an excellent Alchemist,
and his lectures were known for being easy to understand.
But about three years ago, he suddenly resigned...
Just when his research was finally beginning to show promise..."
Touya: "You know a lot about it."
Ymir: "I was working as an assistant in his lab at the time."
Touya: "Huh. So what was he researching?"
Ymir: "The Third Law of Self-Deconstruction and Transformation.
That isn't quite the right way to describe it, but explaining it
in more detail would only make it more confusing..."
Touya: "It's confusing enough already."
Ymir: "Hmm... Put simply, you first break down a person's mind
into its 'most basic components,'
then add something that governs transformation, and study
the interactions that occur...
Let's see... Human abilities depend partly on innate talent,
but sometimes they suddenly blossom, don't they?
Even people called geniuses in your world
weren't necessarily exceptional as children. It's the same thing.
The aim is to explain that. If it succeeds,
it could expand everyone's potential."
Touya: "...So, you mean creating enhanced humans?"
Ymir: "That's a crude way to put it, but that is one aspect.
But, but listen! What's amazing about this research is..."
...Several tens of minutes pass.
Ymir: "...And that is how it is demonstrated on the basis of that theory.
So, this..."
Touya (...Hey, Yamato... Yamato...
Th-that little... She ran away...!)
...Several more tens of minutes pass.
Ymir: "And then, and then..."
Touya: "...S-sorry. I give up..."
Ymir: "Huh? Oh, s-sorry.
I got carried away..."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "W-well, perhaps I'll go
and see how Rayblade is doing..."
Aurelie: "What... did you do to Ymir?"
Touya: "Huh? I didn't do anything."
Aurelie: "Her face was bright red..."
Touya: "If anything, I'm the victim here."
Aurelie: "...???"
Touya: "Anyway, did you want something?"
Aurelie: "Oh, right... I almost forgot.
Everyone's talking about doing some training together.
Are you coming?"
Touya: "Training...? We can't use Zeifon."
Aurelie: "It isn't actual combat.
It's mock training in a simulator."
Touya: "A simulator?"
Aurelie: "A system for simulated combat
in a virtual space. It was originally for training Armored Mech pilots,
and there's one here in the Holy Land.
Well, I've delivered the message."
Touya: "H-hey, wait!"
Ai: "You're laaate!"
Touya: "Oh, shut up.
...So, how do we train here?"
Ai: "Huh? Are you serious?"
Touya: "I don't know, okay?"
Arthur: "The inside of that machine is built just like
a Spirit Mech cockpit. It creates a virtual space
for you to fight in.
Everything is projected onto the monitors,
so it feels just like actual combat."
Touya: "Hmm..."
Ai: "It's a game. You know how there used to be
those robot simulator games?
It's an upgraded version of those."
Touya: "Well, I'll figure it out once I try it."
Fain: "All right! Let's do it!"
Ai: "When did you get here...?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... As a matter of fact, I've just been
officially granted permission to become a Spirit Mech pilot."
Clovis: "Oh?"
Arthur: "I smell politics..."
Fain: "???"
Xiujian: "...Aren't we starting?
If not, I'll be leaving..."
Melvi: "Come on, let's hurry up and play!"
Touya: "Melvi?!"
Melvi: "Eheh heh heh."
Arthur: "She has experience as a test pilot
during Spirit Mech development,
and she was quite insistent about wanting to join us..."
Touya: "Is that safe?"
Melvi: "Yeah! I've played on this machine lots of times,
so I'll be fine!"
Touya: "Oh, so this is what you meant this morning..."
Ai: "Well, sharpening our skills against each other
like this once in a while is good training too.
Let's get started."
Yamato: "Hey, don't leave me out, you knyow!"

review_batches.context: Oswald wakes with Thora and Kururu; Touya wakes at the Clasio home and learns of the council visit. Read the complete 680-row member, including all adjacent scenes.
review_batches.decisions: First draft, full meaning before layout. Preserve every physical row and speaker concealment. Names use the glossary. Continued sentences retain corresponding row boundaries; interjections, hesitation and unfinished thoughts remain deliberate fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o001e3.l00: Use mister for the child's older-man address, answered by Oswald's age joke at 13. Uncle Clime at 23 expresses familiar address, not biological kinship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o00293.l00: Preserve Oswald's interrupted self-introduction and alias correction; the visible speaker label remains Oswald.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o00293.l01: Clime Strass is a provisional phonetic alias; no corroborating external spelling was found. Do not imply it is Oswald's true name.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o0049f.l00: Yamato scolds Touya for making Melvi cry. Restore the addressee explicitly; cat speech localized selectively rather than every Japanese nya sound.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o00680.l00: Preserve written eating/drinking sounds and the sentence across rows 48-51, including the sound-only row 50.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o00765.l00: Ai's calcium quip is character dialogue; retain the joke as written.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o008db.l01: Touya's compulsory attendance is the condition for Ai's refusal, not his offer to go.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o00928.l00: Big Brother Touya preserves Melvi's affectionate older-brother address; it does not assert biological kinship.

review_batches.context: Breakfast concludes; Lodis briefs Touya before Maki's broadcast complicates the council interview. Read all 680 rows, including interview and later revelations.
review_batches.decisions: One source row per English row. Preserve reporting as the reporter's assertions, not narrator fact; distinguish the Agarthian Council from the League Assembly. Split sentence continuations and interruption fragments are intentional. No byte-budget shortening.

row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o00c64.l04: Preserve the reference to yesterday's proposal without inventing its content.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o00f71.l01: Maki's familiar older-sister-style address is rendered by her given name; no biological relationship is asserted.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o00fa2.l00: Maki states certainty; her later theory about Rayblade remains a theory, not established history.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o01240.p02.l00: Preserve the predicted political attack and worst-case proposal, not a decision already made.

review_batches.context: Touya leaves to walk; two concealed conspirators rebuke Lyle and discuss their plans; Clovis begins training. Read all 680 rows and adjacent exchanges.
review_batches.decisions: Keep the four/five-question-mark speakers unidentified. Preserve Doctor as a title without assigning identity or gender, the unnamed female investigator, the three-year wait and conditional claims. Continued sentences, address-only rows and unfinished thoughts are deliberate fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o014dd.l02: The threatened crushing includes the pilot; do not name the machine beyond the source's pronoun.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o01646.l02: Preserve the interruption about the Doctor; no fate or gender is supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o016b6.l03: After announcing Zigrim's war preparations, the speaker asks Lyle to rein in their recklessness; Lyle's acceptance at 190 supports this reading. The subsequent request at 191 concerns Lyle himself and is a separate addressee change.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o01765.l00: With Lyle's response finished, the four-question-mark speaker asks the other concealed speaker to look after him; do not expose either identity.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o01a03.l00: She refers to the female investigator who went out, not an inferred female Doctor. Keep the Doctor's gender unresolved.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o01aa0.l02: That girl carries the speaker's message. Preserve the unclear circumstances rather than identifying the found person as a copy, relative or incarnation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o01c66.l01: Clovis's image is his social persona, not a visual image in the later Prana lesson.

review_batches.context: Clovis explains personal training and Prana, tests Touya's swordsmanship and guides his visualization. Read all 680 rows including the parallel Reduce scene.
review_batches.decisions: Keep teasing, school/dojo history, panting and interrupted questions. Maintain all nine punctuation-only timing rows across the member through an explicit two-dot-leader to two-ASCII-period mapping, with identical wait controls. Row continuations and intentionally unfinished sensations are preserved.

row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o01deb.l01: Retain the distinction between actively piloting and merely being carried by the machine.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o01f7d.l00: Kendo differs from use of a live blade. Touya denies his own school's course and separately confirms sword training; do not make all Japanese people swordsmen.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o021de.l00: Inner thought, not speech to Touya. He learns quickly; no established supernatural cause is asserted.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o02206.l00: Pauses within the question reflect Touya's breathlessness; deliberate split across two physical rows.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o023b5.l00: The second row is the object of picture, deliberately isolated for the instruction's emphasis.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o024a8.l00: Timing-only effect: map each two-dot leader to two ASCII periods; preserve every FC:02:3E wait and the original row boundary.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o024a8.l01: Timing-only continuation; preserve every wait and its position between two-period units.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o024a8.l02: Timing-only continuation; no narration or speaker added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o02899.l00: Touya leaves the sensation unexplained; retain unfinished thought.

review_batches.context: In a separate training encounter, Reduce cuts a rock, lends Touya his sword and teaches Prana visualization. Read all 680 rows and Clovis's parallel lesson.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Hardstone as a provisional ore name, not a real-world material identification. Preserve kilogram units without inventing a weight. Keep conditional training claims, repeated timed punctuation and all row boundaries. Interjections and deliberate trailing thoughts remain fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o02993.l01: Hardstone is an editorial name for the fictional ore; no external spelling or mineral identification established.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o02b65.l00: Keep the distinction between sensing what is there and asking the heart what one wishes to do. Do not turn it into a claim that thoughts alone create matter.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o02e1f.l02: Reduce infers the grandfather's clean sword technique from Touya's movements; this is his assessment, not independently narrated fact.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o02e8b.l03: Possible rapid progress is conditional on serious training; do not promise or confirm that Touya already surpasses Reduce.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o03066.l00: Timing-only effect, explicitly map two-dot leaders to pairs of ASCII periods with identical wait controls.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o03066.l01: Timing-only continuation; retain every wait and physical row boundary.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o03066.l02: Timing-only continuation; add no dialogue or narrator.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o0332b.l00: Keep the sentence unfinished because Touya interrupts with the question about rocks.

review_batches.context: Reduce concludes training; Doris approaches Touya and ignores his objection until Derock interrupts; the council interview begins. Read all 680 rows including Doris's introduction and later recognition.
review_batches.decisions: Retain Doris's coercive claim and Touya's refusal without adding physical detail. Preserve the suspicious/bewitching wordplay's meanings, Derock's verbal tick and music notes, hidden labels and the councilors' contempt. Row continuations and source hesitations are intentional fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o03460.l00: The advice is conditional on remembering the sensation; do not turn that into confirmed mastery.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o034ed.l00: Timing-only training interval; preserve all waits in their exact order.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o034ed.l01: Timing-only continuation, two ASCII periods per source leader.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o0371c.l00: Source contrasts homophones suspicious and bewitching. English preserves the semantic correction; the identical Japanese pronunciation cannot be reproduced literally.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o0388e.l02: This your first time doing something like this stays as ambiguous as the source; no explicit sexual act is supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o03910.l00: Doris's coercive assertion remains her spoken claim, not narrative consent. Preserve Touya's preceding stop request and add no physical detail.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o0399b.l00: Retain the musical note; it needs a native font slot before insertion. Derock's nonsense humming/laugh is localized as sounds, not untranslated prose.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o03a42.l02: Derock mistakenly calls it a tryst; Touya immediately denies it. Retain the repeated you know mannerism.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o03d1c.l00: Emotion-only inner reaction, not spoken dialogue; preserve the distinction from Yamato's later outburst.

review_batches.context: Dei calms Annabella and Wargs and introduces himself; Maki encounters Celica and nearly loses Reisuke to her mechanical curiosity. Read all 680 rows, including Clovis's mistaken interpretation after 560.
review_batches.decisions: Names match the glossary, including Annabella with double n. Keep source label revelation timing, Yamato's accidental speech and fake meow, the five-machine count and Maki's abrupt switch to royal politeness. Sentence continuations and interrupted exclamations remain fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o03e69.l00: Keep the two-question-mark label until Dei's introduction ends, even though the councilors already address him as Chairman.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o040e9.l01: Clasio refers to Ymir, whose answer immediately follows; do not infer Forzen as addressee.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o043d2.l00: Reisuke's electronic sounds are audible beeps, localized rather than kept as Japanese onomatopoeia.

review_batches.decisions: Do not confuse capturing Reisuke with capturing Maki. Preserve Professor as former-teacher address, about-three-year timing, technical research description and enhanced humans without inventing scientific detail. Keep both blank rows and both several-tens-of-minutes timecards. Inner thoughts, trailing explanations and row continuations are deliberate.

row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o0476c.l02: Celica wants to capture Reisuke, the robot, not Maki. Its referent is settled by her preceding demand for it and mechanical curiosity.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o048e5.l00: Professor exposes the previous teacher/student relationship, explained at 582-590. It is not a medical title.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o04ad4.l00: Editorial research-title rendering. Preserve that Ymir immediately calls this description inexact; do not treat it as a real scientific law.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o04c79.l00: Enhanced humans matches the library's human enhancement project terminology. Touya's blunt summary is only one aspect according to Ymir.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o04ce1.l01: Narrative timecard deliberately specifies several tens of minutes, not a few minutes or a precise duration; leading indentation and blank row remain.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o04d38.l00: Touya's inner appeal to Yamato is followed by realization that she escaped the lecture. Yamato's female gender is established by the glossary.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o04d6f.l01: Second timecard adds another several tens of minutes, rather than replacing or repeating the first interval.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o04e48.l00: Ymir's hesitant change of subject after embarrassment; preserve her first-person proposal rather than changing it into a command to Touya.

review_batches.context: Aurelie's invitation leads to simulator training, Fain's newly approved pilot status and Melvi's test-pilot experience. Final 40 physical rows; all 680 rows examined.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve mock combat versus actual combat, simulator-game comparison without inventing a game title, Arthur's political suspicion as his comment, and Melvi's assurances as her claims. Source row boundaries, interruptions and reactions remain intact. Yamato's last complaint retains her cat voice.

row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o052a4.l00: Ai reacts to Fain suddenly joining; do not invent that he just entered a particular door or room.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o0530a.l00: Political implication is Arthur's suspicion, not narration confirming why Fain was approved.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o053ca.l00: Melvi has test-pilot experience during development; do not infer her age, formal employment or combat deployment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_008.o054e4.l00: Yamato asks not to be excluded; preserve her cat voice without changing who is asking whom.
